output.title: IP addresses in Certificate commonName now go to ipAddresses
output.content: The fix changes how certificates whose `commonName` holds an IP address are handled: the IP moves from the DNS subjectAlternativeName list to `ipAddresses`. The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests and has the certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] CRD installed. Inspect the Certificate manifests for any `commonName` containing an IP address, and check whether consumers rely on the old DNS SAN entry. The commonName values are not shown in the summary.
